transcript: Anytime I have the chance to see next to normal I am going to take it. And Connecticut Stage Company has put together an incredible cast for it. Connecticut Stage Company does staged concerts at the New Canaan Library and they're always so well done. I saw their little women, I saw their 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee, just did in the Heights in October, and now they're doing next to normal in may for two days. And if you live in the New York City area, this is a super easy, easy theatre to get to. You can take the train directly from Grand Central. It's like an hour and 20 minutes to New Canaan and then it's like a five minute walk to the library, which to get the chance to hear Elizabeth Stanley's Diana Goodman. You gotta do it! You gotta do it! It's actually wild to me that Elizabeth Stanley has not already been Diana Goodman. Although I guess like Mary Jane in Jagged little pill is sort of adjacent. But I just love Elizabeth Stanley so much and I have to see her do it. AJ Shively as Dan is so perfect. I love his voice so much and I cannot miss him singing one of my favorite songs ever, I am the one. Gabi Carruba as Natalie is like the best thing I've ever heard. Think about her Shelley in bat boy Every single day of my Life. So if you get the chance, next to normal, Connecticut Stage Company, May 2nd & 3rd. May 2nd is an evening show, 7 PM and they have a talk back afterwards with Tom Kitt! And then May 3rd they have a 2PM. So I'm very excited this is happening and I cannot wait to see next to normal again. I love this show just so much.
